messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit Guardian — 24hr hygiene sweep & PO readiness

Morning team,

We have 24 hours before close for a handful of priority deals (see attached commit_tracker_v3.csv). Quick, targeted sweep so we don't leave easy revenue on the table. Please reply with a single-line status and ETA for any outstanding items you own. Key asks: 

- Confirm stage is set correctly in HubSpot and that the close date is today for DEAL-4832 (Contour Analytics).
- Flag any missing procurement docs or PO blockers (who needs a SOW, legal redlines, or billing contact).
- Confirm whether finance has an invoice-ready line item (price + billing cadence) or needs a breakdown.
- If you have an outstanding e-signature/DocuSign link, paste it in the reply.

Action matrix (assignments):
- Priyom: finalize contract redlines + pricing confirmation (Contour).
- Monica: finance signoff & invoice-ready line creation.
- Laura: outreach to procurement for PO formatting and expedite.

Attachment: commit_tracker_v3.csv (live tracker). I will run a combined rollup at 11:30 PT and escalate any stuck deals.

Thanks — keep replies terse so I can compile them quickly.

-David

--
David Kim
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2027 09:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit Guardian — 24hr hygiene sweep & PO readiness

David — quick status (one line each):

- Contour Analytics (DEAL-4832): Pricing confirmed per SOW v2; legal accepted 2 small redlines (payment term -> Net 30, indemnity cap language). I uploaded Contour_PO_worksheet.xlsx with suggested PO fields and vendor name formatting. ETA for signed contract: today EOD contingent on PO receipt.
- Atlas Health: buyer requested revised invoice cadence (monthly -> quarterly). I sent new invoice template at 08:55; awaiting buyer confirmation.
- Meridian Labs: finance needs GL code; Monica please confirm.

Attachments: Contour_PO_worksheet.xlsx (suggested PO fields).

I'll join the 11:30 rollup. If procurement from Contour confirms PO formatting, we can push for a 2pm signature window.

-priyom

David / Priyom — thanks for the heads up. A couple quick clarifications from procurement so we can cut the PO today: 

- Can you confirm the bill-to legal entity? (we have Red Wood Technologies vs Redwood Inference on different docs — prefer the exact legal name for PO).
- Please confirm the one-line invoice description we should use for the PO (product + term).
- Payment terms: contour prefers Net 30; confirm if Net 30 is acceptable.

I attached a procurement checklist internally and cc'd our PO mailbox. If you can reply with the exact invoice line and legal entity by 12:00 PT, we'll issue the PO in the afternoon and forward it to your finance team.

Thanks — Claire
VP, Finance Ops
Contour Analytics

Claire — thanks, quick answers below so procurement can cut the PO: 

- Legal entity for invoicing: "Redwood Inference, Inc." (EIN on file with procurement).
- Invoice description (one line): "Redwood Inference — Dedicated Inference Capacity, 12-month term (Oct 2027 — Sep 2028)"
- Payment terms: Net 30 — accepted.

Monica: can you confirm you have the GL code and billing contact to accept the PO once they send it? If you can confirm now I will ask Claire to issue and route the PO.

Priyom: keep the SOW/contract sign plan in place; if they send PO this afternoon we should be able to execute signature + send invoice by EOD.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/4832), drive worksheet (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1X_sample_drive_commit_sheet)

I'll include the final status in the 11:30 rollup — thanks all for the speedy replies.

-David
